title: okm_len > max returns -EINVAL, UAPI says -EMSGSIZE
description: fd.c:1688-1689: 'op.okm_len > CRYPTO2DEV_KDF_OKM_MAXLEN' returns -EINVAL. UAPI comment says 'Returns -EMSGSIZE if @okm_len > CRYPTO2DEV_KDF_OKM_MAXLEN'. Error code mismatch — callers parsing -EMSGSIZE will never see it; callers parsing -EINVAL can't distinguish 'too big' from 'zero/invalid'. Fix: split the check — okm_len == 0 stays -EINVAL, okm_len > max becomes -EMSGSIZE.
